text:
OH WOW LOOK AT THAT PICTURE IT’S SO COOL!!!

There’s a big, big painting on a wooden stand and it’s like… a whole town with pointy towers and red roofs and LOTS of little people walking around!! And there’s trees with green leaves and blue sky peeking through!! It looks like magic land!!

And guess what?? There’s a person wearing a super funny hat — it’s beige and white and looks like a pirate hat or maybe a chef hat that got squished!! They’re looking at the picture and I bet they’re thinking “WOW THIS IS AWESOME” just like me!!

Oh oh oh! Behind them are more paintings and umbrellas and buildings and everything is so colorful and busy like a carnival but quieter and nicer!!

I wanna paint something like that!! With all the colors!! And maybe add dinosaurs!! Or unicorns!! Wait no — this is already perfect!! 🎨✨
